headline: Shradha Agarwala Files SEBI Takeover Disclosure Under Regulation 31(4) for Texmaco Infrastructure
sum: Shradha Agarwala has filed a mandatory post-acquisition shareholding disclosure with NSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations, triggering Regulation 31(4) reporting for a transaction in Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings Limited.
detail: Shradha Agarwala submitted a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the SAST Regulations, 2011, to NSE regarding a substantial acquisition in Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings Limited. Regulation 31(4) mandates that an acquirer report to the stock exchange a disclosure of shareholding and acquisition details within two trading days of crossing a threshold under Regulation 2(1)(zg) or upon completion of an open offer. The filing was made on 19 June 2026 via official NSE disclosure channels, confirming the transaction has reached a reportable stage under takeover law.
